sentences.en: Being near the Emperor is like sleeping with a tiger.
sentences.zh: 接近皇帝就像和老虎同眠。

sentences.en: Your sovereign is king of Prussia and emperor of Germany.
sentences.zh: 你的君主是普鲁士国王兼德意志皇帝。

sentences.en: The Emperor ordered one of his servants to kill himself.
sentences.zh: 皇帝命令他的一名仆人自杀。
